    • saveOrder

      public int saveOrder(List<OrderLine> lines, Discount discount, double total, String paymentMethod) throws SQLException
      Saves an order in one database transaction: the transaction row, its order items and customizations, and the matching inventory deductions. Rolls back everything on failure.
      Parameters:
      lines - the cart lines to save
      discount - the applied discount, or null for none
      total - the final total including discount and tax
      paymentMethod - how the customer paid, e.g. "Cash"
      Returns:
      the new transaction ID
      Throws:
      SQLException - if no cashier is active, inventory is insufficient, or any insert fails
